# PURISTA LLM Full Context

## Primary reading order
1. https://github.com/puristajs/purista/blob/master/AGENTS.md
2. https://github.com/puristajs/purista/blob/master/website/doc/handbook/index.md
3. https://github.com/puristajs/purista/blob/master/website/doc/handbook/3_eco_system/index.md

## Service design rules
- Use Builder APIs and Zod schemas.
- Keep command/subscription handlers thin and resource-driven.
- Keep versioned service directories.
- Prefer explicit event contracts.
- Keep tests adjacent to behavior.
